analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($64.53) vs SMA5/20/50 ($66.73/$67.97/$68.69): Confirms short-to-mid-term trend breakdown.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($69.02/$64.74): Potential shift to a longer-term bearish trend.
· 52-week position (65.8%) + Current price near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (44.7→39.5): Entering oversold territory, downward momentum continues.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.4837→-0.1574): In negative territory but improving, signaling weakening bearish momentum.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower band $63.62): Approaching the lower band, potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($63.91): Close to Pivot S1 level.
· Swing resistance ($68.35): First resistance zone for a short-term bounce.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: Range-bound, no clear trend formation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.99x): Average trading volume, moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis: Accumulation phase, await confirmation of RSI oversold exit and ADX trend formation before considering entry.
